## DARK WHISPER is playable

The browser prototype includes a first-person raycast game with three story chapters, collectible memories, seal interactions, sanity and lantern-oil meters, a pursuing ghost, pause controls, and an endless Survival mode. It also has keyboard/mouse controls and mobile touch controls.

**Run it:** `python3 -m http.server 3002`, then open `http://localhost:3002`.

**Controls:** WASD or arrow keys to move, mouse to look, Shift to run, E to interact, F to toggle the lantern, and Esc to pause.

I checked the JavaScript syntax, confirmed the chapter targets are reachable, and verified the game renders in-browser without console errors. The latest gameplay screenshot is `screenshots/dark-whisper-playing.jpg`.

**Scope note:** This is a self-contained canvas raycaster prototype—not ultra-realistic 3D. Online co-op and native Android packaging are not implemented.
